messages:
Maria: FYI customer Hearthly reports they completed SSO onboarding but the console shows no API credentials and their API calls return 401. They need to start asap. Tenant id: tenant-7682.
Sam: copying details. do we have any recent deploys touching provision/claim flow?
DeployBot: deploy started - repo: provisioning-service commit: c8f4b9a branch: main env: prod
ProvisionBot: provision_event created: id=0x3a7f, tenant=tenant-7682, api_key=ak_3f9Z... status=provisioned
Alex: can you paste the error they see from the API? also, i'll start by checking DB / claim assignment.
Maria: API response: 401 {"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"no active api key for tenant"}. Customer console shows 0 keys under project. They did the OIDC flow through Okta.
Alex: running quick query: `SELECT id, tenant_id, project_id, active FROM api_keys WHERE tenant_id='tenant-7682';`
Alex: query result snapshot: `[]` (no rows) — odd, ProvisionBot shows an api_key in logs.
Jenna: can you paste the provisioning logs for that event? maybe a timing/race issue between key creation and claim assigner.
Maria: provisioning logs attached (redacted):
```
INFO 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z ProvisionService - start provision id=0x3a7f tenant=tenant-7682
INFO 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z KeyManager - created api_key ak_3f9Z... for tenant=tenant-7682
INFO 2026-03-15T09:12:04Z ClaimAssigner - enqueuing claim for tenant=tenant-7682 -> project=p_104
WARN 2026-03-15T09:12:11Z ClaimAssigner - claim assign delay: 7.2s
ERROR 2026-03-15T09:12:11Z KeyRouter - no active_api_key for tenant tenant-7682
INFO 2026-03-15T09:12:12Z ConsoleCache - cache invalidation for project=p_104
INFO 2026-03-15T09:12:13Z ClaimAssigner - assigned tenant=tenant-7682 to project=p_104
```
Alex: looks like KeyManager created the key but the DB row linking key->project (and active flag) didn't commit before the console/cache check. the `no active_api_key` error came before assign completed.
Sam: hmm, that matches a race we've seen where ClaimAssigner's transaction is separate and sometimes lags under load. any recent changes to claim assigner?
Jenna: there was a change last week to make ClaimAssigner async and we added a small batching queue to improve throughput. I opened an issue yesterday to add stronger ordering guarantees. maybe this is the first customer to hit the window.
Alex: quick mitigation: we can force reconciliation for tenant-7682 which will create the api_keys row and mark it active. endpoint: `POST /internal/reconcile?tenant=tenant-7682` (requires infra token).
Sam: can Support run that now or do you want Platform to run it?
Alex: Platform can run and I'll follow up with a patch to make assignment idempotent + transactional.
DeployBot: deploy finished - provisioning-service @ c8f4b9a (patch: retry claim assign on transient failure)
Alex: reconciliation result: `200 OK` created 1 api_key rows, set active=true, linked to project p_104. console cache invalidated.
Maria: sent customer instructions to refresh console and retest API. asked them to confirm within 10 minutes.
Maria: customer replied: `got the key, calls succeed, thanks!` :party_popper: we'll keep them in trial.
Sam: action items: 1) Jenna to revert/adjust batching to ensure claim ordering OR add strong reconciliation on post-provision. 2) Alex to ship small transactional fix. 3) Support to include forced-reconcile runbook in onboarding KB.
Jenna: will open PR this morning and link it here.
Alex: will add monitoring for 'no active_api_key' spikes in provisioning window.
Maria: closing loop with customer and will monitor. thanks team.
